Date humanity exhausts annual biocapacity; in 2023 around August 2 (Global Footprint Network).
Non-renewable extraction (fossil fuels, metals) reduces remaining stock; renewable above MSY also depletes.
Designs out waste through reuse, repair, remanufacture, recycling (Ellen MacArthur Foundation 2010).
